Sterling 8 cup french press $26.98, normally $65, 60% off

normally $65

It's normally around $30. Good press though, double filter does a solid job of keeping out sediment. My only issue is that the metal holder isn't a great fit around the glass (I suspect that it was manufactured to be slightly oblong on purpose to ensure that it grips the glass tightly -- the alternative being that the manufacturer spends more money to produce holders that are consistently the exact right size). Additionally, the metal holder will start to rust if you put the glass in it before completely drying the exterior.

I should add that it's a nice looking machine. The top part is just a silver plastic that is prone to getting smudge marks, but as long as you're willing to wipe that down now and then this press looks pleasant sitting on a counter or shelf.
